The structure of K2Er6O10 (KEr3O5) is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119), containing 18 atoms per unit cell across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Er centers in an octahedral environment with six O neighbors, while K adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with twelve O neighbors. O centers appear in square-pyramidal and four-coordinate Er environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Er octahedra, and corner-sharing between Er octahedra and K 12-vertex polyhedra.
